exclusion_reason: Every database row is built through a generic engine that stamps a regenerated row hash, refuses an unbacked row (no replay-artifact evidence), refuses a stale row whose revision differs from the current pin, and refuses a personal-data row. The benchmark stays red because a real row needs a real recorded run and rating (BPTK-010) that do not exist, so no real title is regenerable yet.
promotion_trigger: Promote when every declared row regenerates byte-stably from its evidence and the stale and unprovenanced case is refused.
expected_failing_assertion: No database row exists to regenerate.
active_gate_evidence: The database suite covers the regenerable, revision-pinned publishable row, the row-level regeneration from evidence, the unbacked-row refusal, the stale-revision refusal, and the personal-data refusal.
procedure: Regenerate each declared row from its evidence and compare.
Attempt a stale row and an unprovenanced row and assert refusal.
pass_criterion: Stale and unprovenanced row are refused.
